description: Serverless timeout forces PDF generation into a background job.

record.prompt: invoices over ~40 pages fail in production with FUNCTION_INVOCATION_TIMEOUT but work locally
record.assistant: Locally there is no time limit, but on Vercel's Hobby plan a serverless function is killed after 10 seconds, and rendering a 40-page invoice with Puppeteer takes 14-20 s. Upgrading to Pro would raise the limit to 60 s, but you said the budget is fixed at the free tier, so I moved rendering out of the request: the API route now enqueues a job and returns 202 with a job id, and a background worker renders the PDF and uploads it to blob storage. The UI will need to poll for the result.

must_capture.fact: moved PDF rendering to background job
